title: One row of data/news_articles_daily/{run_id}_articles.parquet (schema_version 1, D36)
description: Producer: data/derived/news_articles.py::NewsArticleRecord / articles_build_and_write (collectors/daily_news.py::collect). Consumer: crucible-dashboard views/Daily_News.py, which reads tickers_json, sources_json, published_at, lm_sentiment, event_count off every row via loaders/s3_loader.py::load_news_articles (a plain pd.read_parquet). Validated per ROW (post df.reset_index().to_dict('records')), mirroring the staging_daily_closes contract precedent (data-collector plan P-07, alpha-engine-config-I10870, D36).

aggregate_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (post-parquet-round-trip may serialize as a Timestamp string)

tickers_json.description: JSON-encoded list of tickers; dashboard json.loads()s this

sources_json.description: JSON-encoded list of source slugs; dashboard json.loads()s this
